425:t_2:75.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「Yes... There isn't much I can tell them.」

425:t_2:76.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「They said I could see you for a little while, $n.」

425:t_2:78.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「The military told me why you're here, $n.」

425:t_2:80.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「It's all right. Everyone has a few secrets.」

425:t_2:81.en:
$n
「Why are you here, Miss $$マキ#pilot$$...? And $$シンヤ#pilot$$ and $$ミサコ#pilot$$ too...」

425:t_2:83.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「Around February this year... I left the hospital.」

425:t_2:84.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「There were several reasons, but the biggest was that I thought I could do something for others as a nurse...」

425:t_2:85.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「So I... volunteered to be a nurse on the battlefield.」

425:t_2:87.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「For the same reason you hid the fact that you were fighting, $n.」

425:t_2:89.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「I thought you were an ordinary high school student, $n. I couldn't bring myself to tell you I was going to a battlefield...」

425:t_2:90.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「I knew it was a terrible thing to do, but I thought you'd forget me someday, $n, and go on living your own life as $n...」

425:t_2:92.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「After that, I was at a field hospital in Central Asia when I was caught in one of the Empire's human hunts.」

425:t_2:93.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「...I don't really want to remember what happened next, but after various tests, they brought me to this Earth...」

425:t_2:95.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「I don't really know... They made me shout loudly, forced me through brutal exercise, and sometimes did things like torture...」

425:t_2:97.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「But I'm all right. As you can see... I'm alive.」

425:t_2:99.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「...After I was brought here, the people around me were taken away somewhere, a few at a time...」

425:t_2:100.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「They'd come back after about a month... But when they returned...」

425:t_2:102.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「Yes... I met $$シンヤ#pilot$$ and $$ミサコ#pilot$$ here too.」

425:t_2:103.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「They were already in that state when I met them, though...」

425:t_2:106.en:
$n
「It's all right now, Miss $$マキ#pilot$$. You won't have to go through anything frightening again.」

425:t_2:107.en:
$n
「We'll protect you and the others, Miss $$マキ#pilot$$.」

425:t_2:108.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「I... was hoping you'd say, 'I'll protect you, Miss $$マキ#pilot$$.'」

425:t_2:111.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「When we first met, you seemed so fragile, and sometimes so sad, I couldn't take my eyes off you...」

425:t_2:112.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「Now, you seem strong enough not to lose to anything.」

425:t_2:115.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「I do take pride in having helped you. But you grew stronger through your own strength, $n.」

425:t_2:116.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「Or was there someone besides me who helped support your heart, $n?」

425:t_2:118.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Why don't you make it clear, $n?」

425:t_2:122.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Just a candidate for now, though...」

425:t_2:124.en:
$$ティティ$$
「But I'm not going to lose to his ex.」

425:t_2:125.en:
$$マキ#pilot$$
「Is she the one who supported you, $n?」

425:t_2:128.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Does this... mean the enemy's coming...?」

425:t_2:129.en:
$n
「$$ティティ$$... Please look after Miss $$マキ#pilot$$.」

425:t_3:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Why, $$ジェフリー$$... And everyone is here with you.」

425:t_3:6.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Until today, I've treated you as a comrade and a member of $c.」

425:t_3:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But you've been keeping secrets from us. You're going to tell us everything.」

425:t_3:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Understood. I will issue a code to lift part of my confidentiality obligations.」

425:t_3:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Normally, this would be prohibited for an employee of $$ＤＥＭ$$, but...」

425:t_3:12.en:
$n
「Spare us the excuses. Make your choice now.」

425:t_3:13.en:
$n
「Will you stay an agent robot for $$ＤＥＭ$$, which hasn't even contacted you, or fight with us as a member of $c...? Which is it?」
